headline: Executive order sets rules for issuing permits for facilities and land crossings at US international borders.
what_it_does: This order deals with how the federal government issues permits for facilities and land transportation crossings at the borders of the United States. Such crossings and facilities can include things like bridges, roads, rail lines, or pipelines that cross into Canada or Mexico. The title alone does not explain exactly what process the order creates or changes.

who_it_affects.group: Companies seeking to build or operate border-crossing facilities
who_it_affects.how: They must follow the permit process this order sets for projects that cross a US international border.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that review border permits
who_it_affects.how: Their role in issuing these permits is shaped by the rules in this order.
